_readme: The lineup. Channel numbers are what you punch into the box. Each channel plays from named pools by daypart (days: 0=Sun..6=Sat, local time); gaps between dayparts are off-air (test pattern). Pools list YouTube sources: playlist/channel/video URLs or ytsearchN:query. Every source has a tier: legit (official uploader), wild (unofficial), filler (commercials, bumpers). Tiers in `include` are built for every channel; a channel marked "wild": true also builds the wild sources of its pools, but only while the top-level "wild" master switch is on: flip it to false and rebuild, and every unofficial upload leaves the catalog at once. Wild sources are admitted only after tools/embed_check.js has watched them play (data/embeddable.json). Holiday dayparts ("holiday": MM-DD | easter | thanksgiving) are a soft mix weighted toward whatever is coming up inside the channel's forward window (days, default 90); off season the channel plays a random smattering of all of them. Rebuild with: python3 tools/build_catalog.py Commercials: shows start on the hour or half hour; the padding to the next boundary is commercials, spread as one or two act breaks inside the show (each up to breakSeconds, 150) with the rest after the credits; long broadcasts break about every 15 min. Block (music) channels break every breakEvery seconds between songs. breakEvery 0 on a channel = no commercials.
